exposure: one-time umbilical cord milking after umbilical cord cutting
outcome: probability of not needing a red blood cell (RBC) transfusion during hospital stay
total number of RBC transfusions within 21 days after birth
cohort: The study included 20 infants who received one-time umbilical cord milking after cutting compared to 20 infants from a previous study who received multiple-time umbilical cord milking, all born at less than 29 weeks of gestation.
finding: One-time umbilical cord milking after cord cutting had similar beneficial effects to multiple-time umbilical cord milking before cord cutting in very premature infants regarding RBC transfusion needs.
followup_time: 21 days after birth (for RBC transfusions) and during hospital stay (for transfusion probability)
